label: Gold Dragon
identity: Living mature GOLD DRAGON: antique brass/gold scales, restrained ochre highlights, bronze-brown shadows, cream belly scutes, muted honey/umber leathery wing membranes, swept ivory horns and small amber eyes. This is scaled flesh, NO metallic armor/jewels/crown/coins. FOUR grounded clawed legs plus TWO separate dorsal bat wings (SIX limbs), long rooted tail, stern crocodilian skull/neck; same mature proportions as approved Red Dragon, folded neutral wings below horns. NEVER upright/bipedal/rearing/wyvern. Concept raised-pose study excluded; production always FOUR feet grounded.

label: Frost Troll
identity: FROST TROLL, rangy long-forearmed hunched giant, cold PALE SLATE-BLUE skin with deep steel-blue joint shadows, short FIXED frost-white scalp crest firmly rooted, hooked nose and small deep-set eyes, two small lower tusks, long rooted CLAW fingers, broad grounded bare feet. Simple dark ragged hipwrap bound by rope, rear plain rope knot. No weapons/armor, no ice spikes/magic or loose frost/snow particles. Skin/shaded anatomy same approved Troll with winter color/material. About2.6m hunched/3m upright, do not enlarge beyond approved family. Claws attached through shoulder/elbow/wrist, NO floating crest/hair/hands.

label: Ogre
identity: OGRE visual appearance of existing giant family. WARM GREY/TAUPE skin, broad heavy belly/shoulders, shorter thick neck, blunt square nose/brow, small lower tusks and deep-set eyes, sparse SHORT FIXED dark scalp hair. Huge bare forearms and broad hands with thick rooted claw-like nails, strong grounded bare feet. Simple patched brown hipwrap and rope binding, rear plain knot, no front belt/clasp copied on back. Natural empty-hand fist/claw strike, NO club/hammer/shield or invented armor/weapons. About2.6–3m, SAME physical scale as approved Troll, broader physique without being bigger boss. Hands/feet/garment remain connected in every pose.
